integrity: Self-contained exact proof, four-case symbolic finite transfer with standalone standard-library replay, and independently computed finite checks. No computational observation alone is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet, four literal 32-symbol blocks and complete dyadic regular-paperfolding prefixes of rank k>=5 only; shortest absent subsequences, not all minimal absent subsequences. Historical novelty remains best-knowledge only; no independent external mathematical audit.
title: Exact shortest absent subsequences for dyadic paperfolding words and a four-block concatenation family
